test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Given below are four jumbled sentences. Select the option that gives their correct order forming a meaningful and coherent paragraph.

A. A fine carriage with rubber tyres, a fat coachman, and velvet on the seats, rolled up to the house of a landowner called Gryabov.

B. A drowsy footman met him in the hall

C. "Are the family at home?" asked the Marshal.

D. Fyodor Andreitch Otsov, the district Marshal, jumped out of the carriage.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• First, the scene is set with the **arrival of a fine carriage (A).**
 
• Next, the district Marshal, **Fyodor Andreitch Otsov,** is introduced as he jumps out of the carriage** (D).**
 
• Then, the **drowsy footman** who meets him in the hall is mentioned (**B)**.
 
• Finally, the **Marshal asks if the family is at home** **(C).**

Hence, the correct order is** ADBC**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The order of sentences in a paragraph should follow a logical sequence to ensure coherence and clarity.
 
• Introducing the scene and characters first helps set the context for the reader.
 
• Actions and dialogues should follow logically to maintain the flow of the narrative.
